gold.description: Important business content (products, pricing, company facts) is unavailable in raw HTML and only appears after client-side JavaScript execution

agent.title: Business-critical content is only present after client-side JavaScript execution
agent.evidence: http://localhost:9500/site-003-js-only-facts/ (HTTP 200) serves only 133 characters (17 words) of extractable body text; the element #js-content is empty in the raw HTML and is populated at runtime by inline JavaScript carrying 1440 characters of markup (82 words) across 1 injection sites. Facts visible only after JS execution include the prices "$120, $149, $299, $499".

suggested_action.summary: Server-side render (SSR) or statically pre-render the product, pricing and company sections into the initial HTML response for #js-content inside <main>, keeping JavaScript for enhancement only, and mirror the same values in Product/Offer JSON-LD structured data. Verify with a text-only fetch (`curl`) that the raw HTML already carries the prices, so the facts are machine-readable for AI crawlers and assistants that never execute JavaScript and can be extracted and cited.
suggested_action.mechanism: Most AI retrieval pipelines index the raw HTTP response; content injected by the browser after load is invisible to them, so JS-only facts are simply absent from the model's evidence.

gold.description: Key facts about products, pricing, and company are not accessible to non-rendering crawlers

agent.title: Key business facts cannot be extracted from the HTML by a text-based crawler
agent.evidence: http://localhost:9500/site-003-js-only-facts/ (HTTP 200) yields only 133 characters (17 words) of extractable text, and 4 of 4 fact families are absent from it (missing: company_facts, contact, pricing, product_detail).
